Every biplanar graph is 12-colourable via two Euler bounds and degeneracy.
Published example K6 join C5 has chromatic number 9 and admits thickness two.
note: Published statement retained; independent programme proof is CLM-0007 with validation/sulanke.json.

claim: Historical and modern indexed baseline is 9 <= chi_2 <= 12.
note: Not an exhaustive claim about all 2026 new publications.

claim: The explicit source-reconstructed K6 join C5 graph is biplanar and has chromatic number 9.
note: Classical reconstruction: 26/24-edge layers, two planarity validators, written join/odd-cycle lower bound. validation/sulanke.json.

claim: Every biplanar graph with independence number at most two is 9-colourable.
note: Published textual proof inspected; not externally replayed or programme-formalized. Classical and compiled-check trust retained.

note: Complete elementary proof research/S002_ODD_CYCLE_BLOWUPS.md. C5 overlap known, other overlap possible; novelty unchecked.

claim: An explicitly certified 42-vertex biplanar graph has minimum degree 11 (24 degree-11 and 18 degree-12 vertices) and a proper 7-colouring.
note: CAM-0002 certificate validation/degree11_witness.json; disproves universal 10-degeneracy. Exact chromatic number NOT claimed.

claim: A 12-critical biplanar graph with deficit D=6n-12-m has n>=78+11D; hence every biplanar graph of order at most 77 is 11-colourable.
note: Corollary of external Kostochkaâ€“Yancey Theorem 3, whose full proof is not rebuilt; no universal improved bound. S003 correction: superseded by SRC-0017 Observation 7.1.1 (n>=89, see CLM-0024), which predates S002 and was missed by the S002 prior-art audit.

claim: Identification of independent sets need not preserve biplanarity.
note: Explicit planar matching quotient K12, symbolic proof; no new computation.

claim: In a 12-critical biplanar graph, degree-11 vertices number 24+2D+sum_{d>=13}(d-12).

note: research/S003_FACE_DEFICIT.md Lemma 1.

claim: In a biplanar graph on N>=4 vertices, sum over edges with at most one common neighbour of (2-codegree) is at most 4(6N-12-e).
note: Lemma 2/Cor 3; generalizes the saturated bridge obstruction; overlap with SRC-0017 facial-incidence arguments likely; no novelty claim.

claim: In a biplanar graph with deficit D at least N-4D vertices are wheel vertices in both layers; a 12-critical biplanar graph with D<=11 has at least 24-2D degree-11 double-wheel vertices.
note: research/S003_UPPER_BOUND.md Lemma 6, Cor 7-8; not a reducibility result.

claim: If a planar-union-outerplanar graph has chi>=9, or a union of two outerplanar graphs has chi>=8, then chi_2>=10 (apex / K2-join).
note: Observation 9; elementary, likely known in SRC-0003 (inaccessible).

claim: Every biplanar clique blow-up of a graph on at most 6 vertices is 9-colourable.
note: CAM-0004: reductions R1-R5 proved; zero survivors for k<=6; independent checker agrees k=3..6. Depends on K9 non-biplanarity.

note: Corpus chromatic numbers source-stated.

claim: Every one of the 271 listed alpha>=3 S003 blow-up survivors has chromatic number exactly 10.
note: S004 independently checked F1/F2/F3, 271 bag and 271 vertex DRAT refutations of 9-colourability, and 271 explicit proper 10-colourings. Bag proofs retained compressed; biplanarity not inferred.

claim: Every universal apex of the 159 graphs in the pinned SRC-0017 pool is non-biplanar.
note: 147 Euler exclusions, 8 CLM-0016 exclusions, 4 explicit K9 subgraphs. Last four also have checked face-CNF DRAT proofs. Supersedes S003 apex UNKNOWN obligation only; corpus chromatic numbers not assumed.

claim: For each finite simple labelled n>=4 input supported by the triangulation-cover encoder, biplanarity implies satisfiability of its CNF with any well-formed registered connectivity/link cuts and automorphism lex constraints.
note: Necessary-condition proof in research/S004_TRIANGULATION_COVER.md; allows completion edges outside the input, overlapping layers and exact excess D. Implementation/cardinality/DRAT checker remain trust dependencies. No Lean or universal colouring theorem.

claim: A 122-vertex, 187-edge biplanar graph with a degree-11 double-wheel vertex has an 11-colouring of its deletion for which no single Kempe component swap frees a neighbour colour; the graph itself is exactly 4-chromatic.
note: Explicit layers, colourings and all 55 alternating paths checked; odd C5 wheel supplies chi>=4. D=533, not 12-critical. Does not refute multi-swap, criticality or D<=11 reducibility.

claim: An independent full 8^8-weight audit on each of the fixed bases GsUPOK and GrEKGc agrees with the S003 census for those two bases.
note: GsUPOK: kept 485, colourable 458, F3 19, survivors 8; GrEKGc: kept 71, colourable 61, F3 0, survivors 10. Different chunk enumeration/MIS-cover method and main reruns. Not a full k=8 census check.

claim: Among positive C5 weights in {1,...,8} satisfying the registered F1-F3 filters, there are 297 dihedral classes and 13 maximal classes under dihedral componentwise containment.
note: Full 8^5 enumeration in tools/s004_frontier.py; maximal list archived. This counts necessary-filter patterns, not biplanar graphs or an exhaustive graph universe.
